# Data Source: identitynow_source_provisioning_policy

Use this data source to look up the provisioning policy of a source by usage type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_source_provisioning_policy" "create" {
  source_id  = "2c9180835d191a86015d28455b4a2329"
  usage_type = "CREATE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_id` (String) ID of the source.
- `usage_type` (String) Provisioning operation the policy applies to, e.g. `CREATE`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Provisioning policy description.
- `fields_json` (String) Policy fields as a JSON array.
- `id` (String) ID in the format `<source_id>/<usage_type>`.
- `name` (String) Provisioning policy name.
